name: AgePad
game: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition (Steam, Mac edition, game build 25464371)

inputs.description: Info.plist inside your own Steam install of the Mac game: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/AoE2DE/Age Of Empires II.app/Contents/Info.plist. AgePad reads the whole app from there and Steam for Mac's client libraries from the standard Steam folder, and checks every file against the release recipe.

notes: The release publishes AgePad's own code only (audited by scripts/audit-agepad-base.py). inject adds the player's own Mac game program and Steam client libraries, byte-identical apart from load-command headers. The about 20 GB game data folder is copied to the iPad separately (Finder → Files or scripts/agepad-ipad.sh sync). Needs an iPad with 8 GB of memory; a paid developer account is recommended for the larger memory limit.

publication.reason: The release publishes the app without game or Steam code; PadMint adds the player's own copy, and the result stays personal.
